modern: Everywhere and at all times it is in your power reverently to accept your present condition, and to behave justly to those around you, and to apply your skill to your present thoughts, so that nothing slips into them without being well examined.
original: Everywhere and at all times it is in thy power piously to acquiesce in thy present condition, and to behave, justly to those who are about thee, and to exert thy skill upon thy present thoughts, that nothing shall steal into them without being well examined.
